note: Boxing movements as ordinary content.exercises rows with an empty strength ontology, on the same terms as the mobility vocabulary. ex_boxing_bag already existed this way — it is the only exercise using the `bag` equipment and carries no progression_class — so this adds only its unequipped counterpart.
why_no_progression: Shadowboxing has no load and no rep scheme to advance. progression.ts reads a null progression_class as reps, which is the answer that cannot put weight on anything, and inventing a class for it would be inventing a progression nobody coaches.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing
exercises.notes: Technical work against no resistance. Quality of movement, never output.
